readme:
# Kuaishou Web Share Short URL API

Retrieve a shareable short link for a Kuaishou post by supplying its `photo_id`.

## Use cases

- Generating compact share links for external distribution.
- Embedding shortened links to Kuaishou posts in mobile messaging.
- Simplifying URL presentation across marketing channels.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/kuaishou/web/generate-share-short-url" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"photo_id": "5193494945927590140"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `photo_id` | string | Yes | — |

## Notes

- Requires a valid `photo_id` corresponding to the Kuaishou post.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Kuaishou User ID Lookup](/model/kuaishou/web/get-user-id): Resolves a Kuaishou user ID from a provided user share link.
- [Kuaishou Web Hot List](/model/kuaishou/web/hot-list-v1): Returns the current trending hot list from Kuaishou Web.
- [Kuaishou Web Hot List (V2)](/model/kuaishou/web/hot-list-v2): Returns current trending search rankings and hot topics on Kuaishou web.
